Dear Parent/Guardian,

3rd grade students at Roosevelt Primary will be visiting the Natural History Museum on 2025-04-15. The bus departs at 9:00 AM and returns by 2:30 PM.

A fee of $10.00 covers admission and transportation. Please send cash or check payable to Roosevelt Primary PTA.

Return the signed permission slip by 2025-04-08. Students without signed forms will remain at school.

Questions? Contact Ms. Chen at ext. 215.

IMPORTANT: Immunization Requirements

All students at Hamilton Academy must have current immunization records on file by 2025-09-01.

Required: DTaP (5 doses), Polio (4 doses), MMR (2 doses), Varicella (2 doses), Hepatitis B (3 doses).

Students without complete records will not be permitted to attend classes.

Free clinics at Oak Street Health Center every Tuesday 9 AM-4 PM.

Submit records to school nurse, Room 201.

Jefferson Academy — Spring Concert Invitation

Dear Families,

You are invited to our annual Spring Concert!

Date: 2025-05-10
Time: 6:30 PM
Location: Jefferson Academy auditorium

All family members are welcome. Light refreshments will be served.

No RSVP required. Parking available in main lot.

Ms. Thompson, Event Coordinator

Franklin Elementary — Activity Fee Payment Notice

Dear Parent/Guardian,

The activity fee payment of $15.00 is due by 2025-03-20.

Payment methods: cash or check payable to Franklin Elementary, or online.

Fee waiver applications available in the main office. Free/reduced lunch recipients may qualify for automatic fee waivers.

Late payments may result in inability to participate in activities.

Contact office at 555-3847.

Monroe School Schedule Change Notice

Dear Families,

Please be advised:

Date: 2025-02-14
Change: Early Dismissal — 1:00 PM
Reason: Teacher Professional Development

Bus schedules will be adjusted accordingly.

Monroe School Administration

Attendance Concern — Adams Elementary

Dear Parent/Guardian,

Your child has accumulated 9 absences this semester, exceeding our threshold of 7.

State law requires reporting excessive absences. We would like to schedule a meeting.

Please contact the attendance office at 555-2918 or reply within 5 business days.

If medical, please provide healthcare documentation.

Mrs. Martinez, Attendance Coordinator

Parent-Teacher Conference — Madison School

Dear Parent/Guardian,

You are invited to a parent-teacher conference with Mr. Lee.

Date: 2025-03-25
Time: 3:30 PM
Location: Madison School, Room 112

We will discuss your child's academic progress.

If this time doesn't work, contact us to reschedule.

Translation services available with 48 hours notice.

Mr. Lee

Jackson Primary Bake Sale Fundraiser

Dear Families,

Our annual bake sale is here! Proceeds support library book purchases.

How to participate:
- Donation forms attached
- Return by 2025-04-01
- All items delivered to school

Participation is completely voluntary.

Questions? Contact PTA at pta@jacksonprimary.edu.

Jackson Primary PTA

Free and Reduced-Price Meal Program Application

Dear Parent/Guardian,

Lincoln Elementary participates in the National School Lunch Program.

Household of 4: Free meals under $38,818 / Reduced under $55,266 annually.

How to apply:
1. Complete the attached application
2. Return to cafeteria office by 2025-08-25
3. Notification within 10 business days

Last year's application expires September 30, 2025. You MUST reapply.

Food Services: 555-0189

HEALTH ALERT — Head Lice Reported

Dear Parents,

A case of head lice has been reported in your child's classroom at Washington Middle School.

Please check your child's hair tonight. Look for small tan/brown insects or tiny white eggs (nits) near the scalp.

If you find lice:
- Treat with over-the-counter lice shampoo
- Wash bedding and clothing in hot water
- Notify the school nurse at 555-4421

Your child may return to school after treatment. No need to stay home for nits only.

Nurse Davis
